text: Relay DSH Files Plugin 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的工作区文件浏览面板，通过 Relay Workbench 侧栏显示当前会话工作区。它可以展开文件夹、筛选文件、查看 UTF-8 文本，并在面板内预览 Markdown；预览上限为 256 KiB。文件列表与读取由 DSH Agent 和文件服务提供，只解析当前会话的工作区。需要在同一 DSH Profile 安装 relay-dsh-plugin-workbench；不需要额外 API 密钥。

Relay DSH Files Plugin adds a file explorer to DSH Web. It lists and filters files in the active workspace, previews UTF-8 text and Markdown, and caps previews at 256 KiB. It uses DSH workspace services; install relay-dsh-plugin-workbench in the same profile. No API key is needed.
想在 DSH 会话旁边浏览当前工作区里的文件。
能不能在聊天界面直接打开工作区的 Markdown 和文本文件？
我想快速筛选项目文件，并在浏览器里预览内容。
让 DSH Web 有个侧栏文件树，可以展开目录查看文件。
I want to browse and preview files from the workspace attached to my DSH conversation.
Can I filter a workspace file tree and read Markdown without leaving the chat?
Relay DSH Files Plugin 的功能「工作区文件树」：在 Workbench Files 面板列出当前会话工作区的文件夹和文件，目录可展开，列表可按名称筛选。
Relay DSH Files Plugin 的功能「文本预览」：点击文件后在面板读取 UTF-8 文本，预览最多 256 KiB；Markdown 可切换渲染预览与源文本视图。
Relay DSH Files Plugin 的功能「工作区范围读取」：文件列表和读取请求使用当前会话工作目录，返回目录条目或文本内容，并拒绝工作区以外的路径。

relay-dsh-plugin-files README · Relay DSH Files Plugin：`relay-dsh-plugin-files` adds a right-side workspace file explorer to the
official [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH) Web UI. It lets you browse the active workspace and preview text files
without leaving the conversation.

Workbench in the same DSH Profile.

relay-dsh-plugin-files README · Quick Start With Official DSH：The current development build has been validated with:

- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.1-rc.2`, commit
  [`b150a551`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/b150a551b8d465e31e418e1b2eaf5e79bbb7d28e)
- Node.js 22.13 or newer
- `pnpm` available on `PATH`

DSH is a developer preview and may introduce compatibility-breaking changes.
relay-dsh-plugin-files README · 1. Install：Stop a running DSH Web process before changing Profile plugins.

relay-dsh-plugin-files README · GitHub development build：Use this when you want the latest unreleased development build:

```bash
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1 plugin --profile web add github:yangbobo2021/relay-dsh-plugin-workbench#main github:yangbobo2021/relay-dsh-plugin-files#main
```

For a reproducible install, replace each `#main` with a tag or full commit SHA.
The Workbench package is listed explicitly because DSH's pnpm profile blocks
GitHub packages as transitive dependencies.

relay-dsh-plugin-files README · npm release：Install the published packages with:

```bash
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1 plugin --profile web add relay-dsh-plugin-workbench@latest relay-dsh-plugin-files@latest
```

relay-dsh-plugin-files README · 2. Start or restart DSH Web：```bash
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1 web
```

If you already have a `dsh` command installed, `dsh web` is equivalent. Restart
DSH Web after installing, updating, or removing plugins.

relay-dsh-plugin-files README · 3. Open a workspace：In DSH Web:

1. Open the DSH URL printed by the terminal.
2. Complete the first-launch screen if DSH shows one.
3. Create or select a conversation that has a workspace directory.
4. Open the Workbench side panel and choose `Files`.
5. Click a text file to preview it.

If no workspace session is selected, the panel asks you to open a workspace
session first.

relay-dsh-plugin-files README · What It Provides：- A `Files` view in the Workbench side panel
- Workspace file tree loading through DSH Agent identity
- Workspace containment checks, so previews stay inside the active workspace
- Bounded UTF-8 text previews for practical browser use
- A filter box for quickly narrowing visible files
- Composition with the shared Workbench shell

Binary files, very large files, and paths outside the workspace are not previewed
as plain text.

relay-dsh-plugin-files README · Plugin Boundary and Relay：This plugin owns only the Files view. It does not depend on Codex, Claude, Relay
Events, or any private Relay runtime. It communicates with the shared Workbench
shell through the public plugin contract.

The repository is maintained as part of
[Relay](https://github.com/yangbobo2021/Relay), an open-source project for
long-running agent work, external-event delivery, reusable DSH workbench views,
and multiple conversation backends.

relay-dsh-plugin-files README · Update, Inspect, or Remove：Stop DSH Web before changing plugins, then restart it afterward.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web why relay-dsh-plugin-files
dsh plugin --profile web update relay-dsh-plugin-files
dsh plugin --profile web remove relay-dsh-plugin-files
```

For GitHub installs, `pnpm` records the package source inside the DSH Profile.
Run `dsh plugin --profile web why relay-dsh-plugin-files` to inspect it.

relay-dsh-plugin-files README · The Files panel does not appear：Restart DSH Web after installing the plugin. Then inspect the Profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web why relay-dsh-plugin-files
```

If the package came from GitHub `main`, try pinning a known commit SHA.
